result:
I've fixed all nine reports. The existing suite still passes (617 tests), and typecheck and lint are clean. I also ran a throwaway scenario test that walked through each report; all of it passed, and I deleted it afterwards.

- **Invitations** (`invitation-repository.ts`, `invitation-service.ts`):
  - Links now last 14 days instead of 14 hours.
  - "Pending" now means not accepted, not revoked and not expired. Only pending invitations count toward seats or show on the invitations page.
  - A batch is refused if it names an address twice, names a current member, or names an address that already has a pending invitation. Letter case is ignored, and nothing is created when a batch is refused.
  - Only the account the invitation was sent to can accept it. An invitation to a deleted workspace is refused, and an invitation can only be used once.
  - Re-sending keeps the original role, works on expired invitations, and gives the new link a fresh 14 days.
- **Members** (`member-repository.ts`):
  - Someone who accepts is now an active member straight away.
  - A former member who rejoins gets their old membership back (same id), with the new role, inviter and join date.
  - Removed members can no longer be looked up by id. Removing the same person twice now fails instead of lowering the seat count twice.
- **Sessions** (`session-repository.ts`, `member-service.ts`, `organization-service.ts`): after a removal or a workspace deletion, sessions that were opening on that workspace have their default cleared. Sessions pointed at other workspaces are left alone.
- **Notifications and digest** (`notification-service.ts`, `digest-service.ts`, `notification-preference-repository.ts`): only current members get notifications or the digest. Someone who rejoins starts receiving them again.
- **Seat counter** (`usage-service.ts`, `usage-repository.ts`): joins and removals now recount seats from the members list instead of adding or subtracting one.

Things to review:
- **Existing broken members:** people who accepted before this fix are still stored with the old status, so they still can't act in the workspace. I didn't add a data migration for them.
- **Seat recount:** anything that relied on the old add-one/subtract-one behaviour of those two events will now see the recounted number instead.
- **Re-sending revoked or accepted invitations:** this is now refused. The brief didn't say either way.
